title: Neelkanth Mahadev Temple Rishikesh - History, Timings & Travel Guide
content:
Neelkanth Mahadev Temple - Rishikesh,

The Neelkanth Mahadev Temple is one of the most famous temples of Lord Shiva. It is about 32 km from Rishikesh, surrounded by thick forests and tall mountains. The temple is built at a height of 1,330 meters, which makes the place calm and peaceful.

According to Hindu stories, this is the place where Lord Shiva drank poison during the Samudra Manthan (churning of the ocean). The poison turned his throat blue, and since then, he is called Neelkanth - the Blue-Throated One.

Inside the temple, there is a holy Shivling. Devotees offer water, milk, and flowers to Lord Shiva here. The temple also has carvings that show many stories from Hindu mythology. During Mahashivratri and the month of Shravan (July-August), thousands of devotees visit to take blessings.

Best Time to Visit:

  • Peak Season (October – March): Weather is cool and pleasant, 10°C – 20°C. Perfect for temple darshan and trekking.
  • Moderate Season (April – June): Warm and sunny, 20°C – 35°C. Good for visiting, but carry water and light clothes.
  • Low Season (July – September): Monsoon time, 18°C – 28°C. The area looks green and fresh, but roads may be slippery.

Things to Do near Neelkanth Mahadev Temple:

  • Offer prayers at the holy Shivling.
  • See the mythological carvings on the walls.
  • Take a dip in the kund (holy pond) near the temple.
  • Enjoy a scenic drive or trek through forests.
  • Visit during Mahashivratri for grand celebrations.

How to Reach Neelkanth Mahadev Temple:

  • By Road: The temple is 32 km from Rishikesh. You can go by taxi, jeep, or even trek from Ram Jhula (14 km trek).
  • By Train: Nearest railway station is Rishikesh (32 km).
  • By Air: Nearest airport is Jolly Grant, Dehradun (49 km).

Top 10 Places to Visit Nearby Neelkanth Mahadev Temple (within 50 km):

1- Ram Jhula (32 km) - Suspension bridge across the Ganga.

2- Laxman Jhula (30 km) - Hanging bridge with temples and cafes.

3- Parmarth Niketan Ashram (31 km) - Yoga and Ganga Aarti.

4- Triveni Ghat (33 km) - Evening Aarti on the Ganga.

5- Beatles Ashram (31 km) - Meditation domes and wall art.

6- Neer Garh Waterfall (28 km) - Short trek and natural pools.

7- Rajaji National Park (40 km) - Jungle safaris and wildlife.

8- Kunjapuri Temple (36 km) - Sunrise view from a hilltop.

9- Har Ki Pauri, Haridwar (55 km) - Famous Aarti on the river.

10- Mansa Devi & Chandi Devi, Haridwar (56-58 km) - Ropeway temples.
excerpt: Neelkanth Mahadev Temple near Rishikesh is a holy place dedicated to Lord Shiva. Surrounded by forests and mountains, it is believed to be where Shiva drank poison during Samudra Manthan. With its peaceful location and strong spiritual energy, it is a must-visit temple for every traveler in Rishikesh.
